Column Profile

Source: R/codebook.R
sv_column_profile.Rd

Summarises one column for the column inspector: counts, missingness, distinct values, whether it could serve as a unique key, quartiles and a histogram for numbers, the most common values for text, and data-quality flags (stray spaces, values that differ only in case, numbers stored as text, empty strings, extreme values).

Usage

sv_column_profile(x, top_n = 10L, bins = 20L)

Arguments

x

A vector (a data frame column).

top_n

Number of most common values to keep.

bins

Number of equal-width histogram bins for numeric columns.

Value

A list with kind ("numeric", "character", "logical", "date", "datetime" or "other"), class, label (the "label" attribute, if any), n, n_missing, pct_missing, n_distinct (non-missing), unique_key, stats (named list: min, q1, median, q3, max, and mean, sd for numbers), histogram (breaks, counts), top (data frame of value, n), n_other (distinct values not in top) and issues (character).

Examples

sv_column_profile(c(" Male", "male", "Female", NA))
#> $kind
#> [1] "character"
#> 
#> $class
#> [1] "character"
#> 
#> $label
#> NULL
#> 
#> $n
#> [1] 4
#> 
#> $n_missing
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $pct_missing
#> [1] 0.25
#> 
#> $n_distinct
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $unique_key
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $stats
#> NULL
#> 
#> $histogram
#> NULL
#> 
#> $top
#>    value n
#> 1   Male 1
#> 2 Female 1
#> 3   male 1
#> 
#> $n_other
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $issues
#> [1] "1 value has leading or trailing spaces."                             
#> [2] "1 value differs only in case or spacing (e.g. \" Male\" / \"male\")."
#> 
sv_column_profile(c(54, 61, 47, 999, NA))$issues
#> character(0)
